pinterest.title: Wedding Guest List Template for Google Sheets and Excel, No Sign-up
pinterest.description: Download our wedding guest list template with no sign-up. It opens in Excel as it is and imports into Google Sheets. One row per guest, grouped by Household ID, with columns for contact details, invitation dates, replies for each event, meal choice, dietary needs and allergies, access needs and tables. Dropdowns, frozen headings, filters and a Summary tab are already built, so you can start typing.

pinterest.title: Destination Wedding Guest List Template: Flights, Arrivals and Visa Letters
pinterest.description: A destination wedding guest list needs more than a reply column. Our template adds Travelling from, Flights booked, Arrival date, Departure date, Accommodation, Transport to venue needed, Visa letter needed and Visa letter sent. Filter Flights booked for No to see who still has a seat to find. Visa rules belong to each guest: they should check with the embassy or consulate of the destination before they travel.

pinterest.title: How to Fill In a Wedding Guest List Template by Household
pinterest.description: Start with households, then people. Give each household its ID, add one row per person under it and write the envelope name on the first row only. Settle the plus-one and children rule once, before the first row. For each event, set every guest to Not invited or Invited before anything goes out, so the Summary tab counts who was invited to the welcome dinner, not just who is on the list.

slides: Our wedding guest list template is ready to download, no sign-up. It opens in Excel and imports straight into Google Sheets.
One row per guest. Tie everyone who shares an invitation together with one Household ID, and write the envelope name on the first row only.
One column per event: welcome dinner, ceremony, reception and recovery brunch. Each takes Not invited, Invited, Attending or Declined.
Meal choice and dietary needs sit in separate columns. A preference changes a plate; an allergy changes how the kitchen works.
Guests flying in? Track where they are travelling from, flights booked, arrival and departure dates, accommodation, transport to the venue and visa letters.
Visa rules belong to each guest. They should check with the embassy or consulate of the destination before they travel. Send that reminder with the save the date.
Names, addresses and phone numbers are personal information. Share the file only with the people helping you plan, view-only where you can. General information as at November 2026, not legal advice.

instagram_carousel.caption:
A wedding guest list template should be a download, not a sign-up form. Ours is an Excel file you can open as it is or import straight into Google Sheets, with no sign-up.

Inside the template:
- One row per guest, grouped by Household ID, so you can count meals, seats and flights by person and invitations by household.
- A column for each event: welcome dinner, ceremony, reception and recovery brunch.
- Meal choice kept apart from dietary needs and allergies, plus a column for access needs.
- Destination columns for where guests are travelling from, flights, arrival and departure dates, accommodation, transport to the venue and visa letters.
- Dropdowns, frozen headings, filters and a Summary tab that counts for you as you type.

Visa rules belong to each guest. Every guest should check with the embassy or consulate of the destination before they travel.

A guest list is a small database of other people's lives. Share it only with the people who need it, keep it out of group chats and screenshots, and delete it or move it somewhere private once the thank you notes have gone. General information as at November 2026, not legal advice.

When replies start arriving from different countries, Wonderland Studio, our planning app for seating charts and RSVPs, saves the retyping.

Planning the wedding itself abroad? Message us to talk it through with a Wedded Advisor. Template and full guide at the link in bio.
